spanish: Lo que alcanzare su mano, el uno pecado y el uno holocausto, sobre la minjá; y expiará el sacerdote sobre el que se purifica delante de Jehová.

findings.issue: חַטָּאת (lemma 2403 b, feminine singular noun) remains open between sin and sin-offering; pecado resolves it to abstract sin and drops the offering sense licensed in parallel with עֹלָה.
הַמִּנְחָה is a common noun, not a proper name; minjá leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
עַל is only marked as a preposition (upon, over, concerning, in addition to); sobre narrows it toward a spatial on.

notes: Person, number, hiphil with יָדוֹ, piel כפר, hithpael participle, and Jehová match the tokens.
